sloka: ततः पर्वतमुत्पाट्य द्विविदः प्लवगर्षभः।दुद्राव गिरिशृङ्गाभं विलम्ब इव तोयदः ।। ६.६७.९ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ parvatamutpāṭya dvividaḥ plavagarṣabhaḥ।dudrāva giriśṛṅgābhaṁ vilamba iva toyadaḥ ।। 6.67.9 ।।

translations.english: The Vanaras collected from here and there, having restored confidence in themselves with great difficulty, held trees and mountains and stood in the forefront of the battle.
